page.layout: One page of text in a single column; marginal notes and reference marks in the right margin (small signs, partly illegible); catchword-like word "Ridet," at the foot right under the last line.

main_text.p: V oce canent memores gratia Endymiona minores, Endymioná, suo quem Delia candida fratri Pratulit, mutila V eneris confixa sagitta, Collibus in Lelegum, quà Caria celsa profundo Imminet Ægeo, pulchros dum flumina propter Pascit agens tauros, iuvenum pulcherrimus ipse, Endymion teneris senssim imbibit ossibus ignem, Non illi Dryades, nec amantes prata Napaeae Perculsere animum, quanquam per prata Napaeae Sape agerent choreas, nudata crura pedesque Brachiaque, & flavam per lactea colla refusa Cafariem, quanquam Dryades sub fronte latentes Sape recedentem sequerentur, saepe sequentem Profugerent visa, & cuperent fugiendo videri. V nius in vultu Lunae sic vultibus haerens Spectat inexpleto fugientem lumine, spectat Mane recedentem, & tacito sua gaudia voto Nutrit vota ausus nondum committere verbis, Ut furor increuit, maiorque infamia morbi Expressit veras flagranti e pectore voces, Sape super Latiae frondosa cacumina pernox Spectabatque Deam, spectadisque fouebat amorem Et gemitu, & vanis tundebat faxa querelis. O nemora, o fontes, & amica frondibus umbra, Antraque sauarum latebris horrenda ferarum, Si qua latet radix aut graminis herba salubris, Qua leuet infanos vel collai pectoris aestus, Ferte salutiferum vestro medicamen alumno, Sed neque surda meis flectitur fax a querelis, Nec nemora & fontes, nostrodea sola dolori Auxilium tu ferre potes, dea cuius ab ore Herba bibit sitiens rores, mare gestiu, & aether Ridet,

page.notes: Marginal reference marks and small notes in the right margin are too faint or fragmentary to transcribe reliably. Several words in the verse are doubtful (e.g. "senssim", "spectadisque", "fax a", "nostrodea", "collai"); the printed Latin is set in italic and the scan is blurred, so these readings are uncertain and should be checked against the original.
